OFFICIAL EAST RAPTI MAINSTEM FORECAST GAUGE, 61.7km upstream of Bharatpur. Used as an upstream lead-time/forecast signal, not a local-stage proxy -- it is the only mainstem gauge available for this river, so it remains active despite the distance. Confirmed still active on DHM's live river-watch list as 'East Rapti at Rajaiya'.

NOT USED as a river-level input: this gauge measures Manahari Khola BEFORE its confluence with East Rapti, i.e. tributary inflow, not mainstem stage. Using it as a mainstem proxy would require basin routing/summation logic beyond this project's scope. Kept here for reference only -- its rainfall/runoff contribution is already partially captured via nearby rainfall stations.
NOT USED as a river-level input: same reason as Manahari -- measured before confluence with East Rapti mainstem. Reference only.
